name: bojaina journey
source:
Roney is an ordinary high schooler drifting off to sleep. Suddenly, she wakes up in the middle of a jungle, some kind of dense forest, surrounded by dinosaurs.

Lost, terrified, and with nowhere to hide, she’s forced to run and make decisions that may determine whether she survives.

[From [url=https://toublu.itch.io/bojaina-journey-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
罗尼是一名普通的高中生，正在渐渐入睡。突然，她在丛林中醒来，某种茂密的森林，周围都是恐龙。

迷失、恐惧、无处可藏的她被迫逃跑并做出可能决定她是否生存的决定。

[来自[url=https://toublu.itch.io/bojaina-journey-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
